title: 第一卷 第14章 你在嫌弃我？
content_zh:
冯姿送童喻到了单元楼下。

    她看着这老破旧的房子，皱眉，“你要不换一个地方住吧。这里看着都不安全。”

    没有保安，没有门禁，谁都能进这小区的。

    童喻四处看了一下，“其实这小区挺好的，都是些大爷大娘。见了面，还会打招呼。他们记性可好了，只要出现个生面孔，都会警惕的。”

    “我就是觉得太破旧了。”冯姿是不放心童喻的。

    童喻长得年轻漂亮，万一被有心人盯上，可就不好了。

    “真没事。”童喻拍拍冯姿的肩膀，“赶紧回去休息吧。路上骑车慢一点。”

    “行吧。走了。”

    童喻看着冯姿骑着车出了小区，才转身上了楼。

    现在太早了，但是老人家们基本都已经起床了。

    童喻住在四楼，拿出钥匙打开斑驳的铁门，进去关上了门。

    刚换了鞋子，就有人敲门了。

    知道她住这里的人有限，这么早来找她的人，也不多。

    童喻打开了门，看到胡文。

    “姐。”胡文冲她咧嘴一笑，露出两排白净好看的牙齿。

    童喻诧异，“这么早你怎么来了？”

    胡文把手上的东西提起来，给她看，“给你送这个来的。”

    他手里拎着一个大纸箱子，不知道是什么。

    童喻让他进来，“你请假了吗？”

    “请了。”胡文把东西放在桌上，“你自己打开吧。我得回去上早自习了。”

    童喻盯着那个箱子，“到底是什么？”

    “你自己看，我也不知道。”胡文把神秘感拉满。

    他走到门口，童喻送他出门，“你还有钱用吗？”

    胡文笑着说：“有的。这个月你不用给我生活费了。”

    “也不用太省。没钱了，跟我说。”童喻对这个同母异父的弟弟总归还是有些感情的，他出生在家的那两年，她只要一放学回来，都会陪着他玩的。

    胡文点头。

    他刚侧身，又转回来，“姐，爸那里……”

    “不用担心。”童喻给了他一个安心的眼神，“你只管好好学习就行了。别的事，就不要多想。”

    胡文看着姐姐，心里也不是滋味。

    如果他是哥哥多好了，这样就不需要她一个人扛了。

    “赶紧回去上课。”

    “嗯。走了。”

    胡文下了楼，童喻重新把门关上，走到桌边，看着桌上的那个箱子，她打开了。

    拆开后，童喻愣在了原地。
content_en:
Feng Zi sent Tong Yu downstairs to the unit.

    She looked at the old and dilapidated house and frowned, "Why don't you live somewhere else. It doesn't look safe here."

    There are no security guards or access control, so anyone can enter this community.

    Tong Yu looked around and said, "Actually, this community is quite good. They are all old men and women. They will say hello when they meet. They have very good memories, and they will be wary as long as a new face appears."

    "I just think it's too shabby." Feng Zi was worried about Tong Yu.

    Tong Yu is young and beautiful, but it will be bad if someone is interested in her.

    "It's okay." Tong Yu patted Feng Zi on the shoulder, "Go back and rest quickly. Cycle more slowly on the road."

    "Okay. Let's go."

    Tong Yu watched Feng Zi ride out of the community before turning around and going upstairs.

    It's too early now, but most of the elderly have already gotten up.

    Tong Yu lived on the fourth floor. He took out the key and opened the mottled iron door, went in and closed the door.

    As soon as I changed my shoes, there was a knock on the door.

    There are only a few people who know that she lives here, and not many people come to see her so early.

    Tong Yu opened the door and saw Hu Wen.

    "Sister." Hu Wen grinned at her, showing two rows of white and beautiful teeth.

    Tong Yu was surprised, "Why are you here so early?"

    Hu Wen lifted the thing in his hand and showed it to her, "I brought this to you."

    He was carrying a large cardboard box in his hand, and he didn't know what it was.

    Tong Yu asked him to come in, "Have you asked for leave?"

    "Please." Hu Wen put the things on the table, "You can open it yourself. I have to go back to study in the morning."

    Tong Yu stared at the box, "What on earth is it?"

    "You can see for yourself, I don't know either." Hu Wen filled the air with mystery.

    He walked to the door and Tong Yu saw him out, "Do you still have money?"

    Hu Wen smiled and said, "Yes. You don't have to pay me living expenses this month."

    "Don't worry too much. If you have no money, just tell me." Tong Yu still has some affection for this half-brother. In the two years when he was born at home, she would play with him whenever he came back from school.

    Hu Wen nodded.

    He just turned sideways, then turned back, "Sister, dad's place..."

    "Don't worry." Tong Yu gave him a reassuring look, "Just study hard. Don't think too much about other things."

    Hu Wen looked at his sister and felt uncomfortable.

    It would be great if he was an older brother, so she wouldn't need to carry it alone.

    "Go back to class quickly."

    "Yeah. Let's go."

    Hu Wen went downstairs, and Tong Yu closed the door again, walked to the table, looked at the box on the table, and opened it.

    After taking it apart, Tong Yu froze on the spot.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 14 Do you dislike me?
